summary: Columbia County lookout built 1940, used by volunteer aircraft observers under the Portland Filter Center in the 1940s, and removed or destroyed in 1965. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Removed or destroyed in 1965. No source describes what remains on the mountain today.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says removed in 1965 and firelookout.com says destroyed in 1965; the Oregon history also records removal in 1965. The year agrees across sources; the verb does not.

The Oregon history does not say the site was an aircraft observation post in so many words; it lists the site under the Portland Filter Center, refers to AWS construction, and describes its observers doing aircraft observation work. The story describes only what those entries say.

notes_for_editor: The record's two location points (FFLOS 45.79771, -123.04986; West US Lookouts 45.81284, -123.05064) are about 1.7 km apart; the story does not choose between them. The record's height_m is null; the 20-foot figure is listed under design and not as a height. A map-database label 'Pisgah Lookout' in Columbia County turned up in search, but it has no history, so it is not cited. Two web searches found no source on the current site condition. Verification 2026-10-09: the story said the site was activated 'as an aircraft observation post'; the Oregon history gives the Portland Filter Center listing and the volunteers' aircraft observation work, but not that label, so the story now says only that. The register's 'Administered by' field is now quoted as the administering agency.
